notes.title: Update Notes: Better Readability & Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! A new update is live with a few improvements and fixes:

[list]
[*]Increased text size and UI elements for better readability
[*]Added zoom in/out to the skill trees
[*]Potential fix for windowed mode not working (this bug doesn’t happen on my machine, if you’ve experienced it before, please let me know if this resolves it!)
[*]Fixed the 'Shell Shock' skill so it now correctly increases bomb radius
[/list] 

Thanks as always for the feedback, it helps me catch things I might miss on my end. Please let me know if you run into any other issues!

notes.title: Major Update – Mac, Steam Deck, More Languages & a Discount! 🎉
notes.notes:
[p]Commanders, big news from the front! We’ve been hard at work improving [b]Click and Conquer[/b], and today we’re rolling out one of our biggest updates yet.[/p][h2][b]MacOS Support[/b][/h2][p]Mac players, your time has come! [b]Click and Conquer[/b] is now fully playable on macOS.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Steam Deck Verified[/b][/h2][p]We’re happy to announce the game has officially passed Valve’s checks and is now [b]Steam Deck Verified[/b], take your bombing campaign on the go![/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Languages Added[/b][/h2][p]Our forces are now fluent in even more languages! The game now supports:[/p][list][*][p]Traditional Chinese (zh_Hant)[/p][/*][*][p]Italian (it)[/p][/*][*][p]Portuguese – Portugal (pt_PT)[/p][/*][*][p]Thai (th)[/p][/*][*][p]Polish (pl)[/p][/*][*][p]Danish (da)[/p][/*][*][p]Dutch (nl)[/p][/*][*][p]Finnish (fi)[/p][/*][*][p]Norwegian Bokmål (nb)[/p][/*][*][p]Swedish (sv-SE)[/p][/*][*][p]Hungarian (hu)[/p][/*][*][p]Czech (cs)[/p][/*][*][p]Romanian (ro)[/p][/*][*][p]Turkish (tr)[/p][/*][*][p]Bulgarian (bg)[/p][/*][*][p]Greek (el)[/p][/*][*][p]Ukrainian (uk)[/p][/*][*][p]Vietnamese (vi)[/p][/*][*][p]Indonesian (id)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Potential fix for the [b]windowed mode bug[/b] that some players have been experiencing. If you’ve had trouble before, please give it another try and let us know![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your support, feedback, and for blowing things up with us.
Onward to victory! 💣[/p]

notes.title: Bug Fixes & Quality of Life Changes
notes.notes:
[h3]🛠️ Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Windowed‑mode sizing[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that prevented players from changing the window size when not in full‑screen.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]✨ Quality of Life[/h3][list][*][p][b]“Ready / Go” pop‑up[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now skip the intro banner at the start of each minigame, tap or click once and jump straight into the action.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]🏆 Steam Achievements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Retroactive unlocks[/b][/p][list][*][p]Some players reported issues with Steam not recognizing achievement unlocks. In order to remedy this the following will unlock automatically the next time you launch the game if you’ve already met their requirements:[/p][list][*][p][b]You Monster[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Tip of the Spear[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Knowledge[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Feed the Snail[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Deja Vu[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Spy Craft[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Scorched Earth[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Pyrrhic Victory[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Greedy[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Remaining achievements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Sadly, we can’t verify past progress for the rest of the list, so you’ll need to earn them again. The upside: you should be able to re‑farm them in record time. 💪[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Thank you for every bug report and suggestion, please keep them coming.
See you in game![/p][p][/p][p][b]Cheers,[/b]
[i]Sockhouse[/i][/p]

notes.title: Improvements, and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]First off, [b]a huge thank you[/b] to everyone who played the demo and sent feedback during Next Fest. Your support, bug reports, and kind words mean the world. It’s been amazing seeing so many of you enjoy the game!
[/p][p]We’ve just pushed an update to the demo with some tweaks and fixes based on your input:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Change:[/b] Increased minigame camera zoom by 20% for better visibility.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fix:[/b] Minigame status panel no longer starts in the wrong position.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fix:[/b] Prestige modal now correctly hides the "unspent intel" warning when there’s nothing to spend.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fix:[/b] Audio now defaults to proper levels on first launch.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fix:[/b] Camera no longer snaps weirdly after prestiging.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This should make the overall experience feel smoother and more polished. If you haven’t checked out the demo yet, now’s a great time![/p][p][/p][p]As always, keep the feedback coming, we're listening, and we appreciate every bit of it.[/p][p]Thanks again for playing and supporting the game 💖[/p]
